name: bounded dynamic LP fee remains blocked until the mandatory volume fee is integrated
description: A dynamic LP fee can be structurally reviewable, but it belongs to LPs and cannot replace the mandatory Programmable hook-owned volume fee. This scenario remains changes-required until that fee is integrated into the same hook.

model.name: Bounded Depth LP Fee
model.summary: Lower the pool LP fee when a fixed-size window of finalized prior-block active-liquidity samples becomes deeper.
model.userOutcome: Liquidity providers receive a bounded LP fee that responds to sustained active liquidity without creating creator revenue or scanning initialized ticks.
model.whyV4: A v4 beforeSwap callback can read one PoolId, update a bounded observation ring and apply one bounded LP-fee override atomically.

lpFee.overrideFlagPolicy: Every supported swap returns a fee inside immutable bounds with the dynamic-fee override flag set.
lpFee.updatePath: afterInitialize records the nonzero initial fee; beforeSwap reads active liquidity once, updates one slot in a fixed eight-slot PoolId ring and applies a fee derived only from prior-block slots.
lpFee.inputMetric: The PoolManager active-liquidity value at the current tick from one StateLibrary getLiquidity read for the admitted PoolId; no positions, tick words or initialized ticks are traversed.
lpFee.referenceAsset: No external reference asset; immutable thresholds use this PoolId's raw active-liquidity units.
lpFee.measurementUnit: The uint128 active-liquidity value returned for the exact admitted PoolId.
lpFee.observationWindow: Exactly eight finalized prior-block samples in a fixed-size ring; missing slots keep the initial fee.
lpFee.curve: Four immutable raw-liquidity thresholds map the lower median, the fourth value after sorting eight samples, to one bounded fee tier; evaluation uses a fixed eight-input sorting network and four comparisons.
lpFee.updateCadence: At most one stored sample per PoolId per block and one fixed-size evaluation per beforeSwap call.
lpFee.liquidityDecreaseBehavior: A lower median of the fixed prior-block samples selects a higher fee tier inside the immutable bounds.
lpFee.manipulationResistance: The current transaction's sample cannot set its own fee; tests cover same-block add-swap-remove, multi-block temporary liquidity, donations, tick crossings and split routes, and enforce an eighty-thousand-gas beforeSwap ceiling with a full ring.
lpFee.failureRule: Use the initial fee until all eight slots are finalized; later read, cast or bound failures keep the last valid fee and emit a stale-observation event.

callbackPolicies.necessity: The dynamic pool starts at zero, so this callback stores the exact nonzero initial LP fee.
callbackPolicies.allowedReverts: Only invalid PoolId admission or failure to set the bounded initial fee may revert initialization.
callbackPolicies.userExitImpact: Initialization happens once and cannot govern a later liquidity or token exit.
callbackPolicies.noSelfCallImpact: The model initiates no same-hook PoolManager action during initialization.

callbackPolicies.necessity: Each swap needs one bounded LP-fee override derived from the latest finalized observation.
callbackPolicies.allowedReverts: Only invalid PoolId admission or an out-of-bounds fee calculation may revert the swap.
callbackPolicies.userExitImpact: The callback affects trading only and cannot block standard liquidity removal.
callbackPolicies.noSelfCallImpact: The model initiates no nested swap and does not rely on recursive callbacks.

valueFlows.amountRule: Core applies only the flagged LP fee between 500 and 5000 hundredths of a basis point.
valueFlows.settlement: The hook returns no token delta and never takes custody; the standard router settles the complete swap.
valueFlows.failure: An invalid or unavailable observation keeps the last valid bounded fee or reverts before settlement.

operations.monitoring: Index fee observations and stale-observation events; alert on bounds violations or callback reverts.
operations.incidentResponse: The immutable bounds cannot be changed; a faulty model is retired for new pools without blocking existing liquidity exits.

rationales.complexity: Two callbacks coordinate initialization and one bounded per-swap LP-fee override.
rationales.customMath: A fixed eight-input sorting network and four immutable threshold comparisons select one bounded LP-fee tier.
rationales.externalDependencies: The model reads only admitted pool state and uses no external oracle or service.
rationales.externalLiquidity: The hook holds no token, liquidity position, PoolManager claim or beneficiary balance.
rationales.valueAtRisk: The hook returns no token delta and cannot transfer or custody trader or LP principal.
rationales.teamMaturity: A conservative nonzero process score remains until independent reviewers complete their work.
rationales.upgradeability: The hook, fee bounds and observation rules are immutable for the pool.
rationales.autonomy: The selected LP fee changes automatically from the fixed-size prior-block observation ring.
rationales.priceImpact: The LP fee changes final execution inside the immutable five-to-fifty-basis-point range.

disclosures: The LP fee belongs to liquidity providers and does not satisfy the mandatory Programmable volume fee.
The fee input uses exactly eight prior-block active-liquidity samples; it never scans positions, tick words or initialized ticks.
A low numeric score does not override the high review tier imposed by automatic price-impacting behavior.
